name: Conan
description: A late night television talk show hosted by  Conan O'Brien.

videos.title: Team Coco Presents: The Conan Writers Live
videos.overview: Andy Richter, Reggie Watts and several of Conan O'Brien's writers will team up for the one-hour special Team Coco Presents The Conan Writers Live. This show has played to sold-out audiences in Los Angeles and is coming to Chicago for one night only. Richter was O'Brien's sidekick on Late Night with Conan O'Brien from 1993 to 2000, before venturing out to star in Andy Richter Controls the Universe and Andy Barker, P.I., and then returning to join O'Brien as announcer for The Tonight Show with Conan O'Brien.

videos.title: Show Zero
videos.overview:
"Conan, what's your new show going to be like?"

 In this web series finale, you'll find out - as Conan invites 20 real life fans to the CONAN offices... To witness the fastest talk show in the history of the world.*

WELCOME TO THE FUTURE. WELCOME TO SHOW ZERO.

videos.title: Conan O'Brien Can't Stop
videos.overview: A documentary that follows the former Tonight Show host. Filmed during Conan’s ”Legally Prohibited From Being Funny on Television” comedy tour, after his departure from the Tonight Show, takes viewers into an intimate journey of O’Brien’s life.

videos.title: The Conan One Hour Earlier Best of Spectacular
videos.overview: Compilation special showcasing the best moments from the past one year, one month, 4 days, 23 hours of Conan.

videos.title: SJJ: Edmund Morris
videos.overview: In "Serious Jibber-Jabber," Conan O'Brien has lengthy, uninterrupted conversations with interesting people on topics which fascinate him. In this first episode, Pulitzer Prize-winning Teddy Roosevelt biographer Edmund Morris visits for a free-wheeling chat about the remarkable achievements and complexities of the larger-than-life 26th President -- and how modern presidential candidates stack up to history.

videos.title: SJJ: Judd Apatow
videos.overview: In "Serious Jibber-Jabber," Conan O'Brien has lengthy, uninterrupted conversations with interesting people on topics which fascinate him. In this episode, Judd Apatow, the man behind such hits as "Anchorman," "Knocked Up," "Bridesmaids," and "This Is 40" joins Conan to touch on the nature of comedy writing rooms, breaking into showbiz and how Judd’s greatest dream was to write an episode of "The Simpsons.

videos.title: SJJ: Nate Silver
videos.overview: In "Serious Jibber-Jabber," Conan O'Brien has lengthy, uninterrupted conversations with interesting people on topics which fascinate him. In this episode, Nate Silver, the statistical whiz behind the New York Times' FiveThirtyEight blog, which correctly predicted the winner in all 50 states in the 2012 Presidential Election, sits down with Conan to talk about hard data, trusting your gut instinct, and the power of perception...all while wearing a Cookie Monster t-shirt.

videos.title: Serious Jibber-Jabber: Rocker Jack White
videos.overview: On "Serious Jibber-Jabber," Conan O'Brien has lengthy, uninterrupted conversations with interesting people on topics which fascinate him. In this special episode shot entirely on 35mm film, Conan and Grammy-winning musician/producer Jack White talk for over an hour over drinks about art, success, and upholstery. Yes, upholstery.

videos.title: Serious Jibber-Jabber: “The Simpsons” Writers Reunion
videos.overview: On "Serious Jibber-Jabber," Conan O'Brien has lengthy, uninterrupted conversations with interesting people on topics which fascinate him. In this special round table episode, "The Simpsons" scribes Al Jean, Mike Reiss, Jay Kogen, and Jeff Martin reunite with Conan for a rollicking 80-minute discussion about comedy, fatherhood, and the early days of the pioneering animated show.

videos.title: Serious Jibber-Jabber: Music Historian Peter Guralnick
videos.overview: Acclaimed music historian Peter Guralnick joins Conan on Serious Jibber-Jabber to discuss the titans of early Rock and Roll: Sam Cooke, Sun Records, and Elvis Presley.

videos.title: Serious Jibber-Jabber: Martin Short
videos.overview: Comedy legend Martin Short joins Conan O'Brien for a rollicking hour-long chat about SCTV, SNL, Ed Grimley, and why having a dad who's kind of a jerk makes you funnier.

videos.title: Serious Jibber-Jabber: Mel Brooks
videos.overview: Director Mel Brooks and Conan O'Brien enjoy a long, rollicking conversation about comedy, the nature of performing, and the people who've influenced and figured prominently throughout Mel's legendary career.

videos.title: Serious Jibber-Jabber: Historian A. Scott Berg
videos.overview: Pulitzer Prize-winning historian A. Scott Berg talks with Conan about Woodrow Wilson, including his hesitant path to World War I, how his wife secretly ran the White House, and what Barack Obama can learn from the 28th President.

videos.title: Serious Jibber-Jabber: Documentarian Ken Burns
Serious Jibber-Jabber: Author Michael Lewis
videos.overview: Conan talks with Michael Lewis, the author of Flash Boys & Moneyball on Wall Street's desperate need for oversight, why the financial market should look for a responsible, overpaid "son of bitch," & how he gets pumped up by listening to the "Frozen" soundtrack.

videos.title: Conan To Go
videos.overview: A collection of the best moments from Conan ditching the studio and exploring the world around him. Conan To Go is a prime-time special that originally aired on 18th of December, 2014 and featured the best of Conan's remote segments.

videos.title: Serious Jibber-Jabber: Author Erik Larson
videos.overview: Conan sits down with one of his favorite authors, Erik Larson (The Devil in the White City, In The Garden of Beasts, Dead Wake) for an in-depth discussion of early 20th century history, the pleasure-pain of writing, and Conan's favorite subject: murder.

videos.title: Serious Jibber-Jabber: Author Evan Thomas
videos.overview: Conan sits down with acclaimed author Evan Thomas (Sea of Thunder, Ike's Bluff, Being Nixon) for an in-depth discussion on dirty trickster, Kennedy frenemy, and secret film nut, Richard Nixon.

videos.title: Serious Jibber-Jabber: Author Richard Zoglin
videos.overview: Conan discusses Richard Zoglin’s new biography of Bob Hope, which reveals that Hope was one of the first multimedia celebrities, starting in vaudeville, moving to radio, and inventing stand-up comedy as we know it.

videos.title: Serious Jibber-Jabber: Author Mark Lewisohn
videos.overview: Conan talks with acclaimed Beatles biographer Mark Lewisohn, whose biographical history trilogy delves into the Fab Four as never before and explains why Paul & Ringo might actually be the worst authority on the Beatles.
